summary: Iteration 15: end-to-end verification of the Essential Mirror TIE STATE (TIE_MARGIN=5) plus regressions on the four other instruments, combined PDF, Flag/Junction anonymous flows, /methodology copy, ownership enforcement, and the CI portability guard. All 13 backend tests in test_iteration15.py pass against the deployed preview; the local pytest suite runs 157 passed on /app/tests. The tied session dd53396e (owner test.user@ratherknow.com, every essential item = 3) renders on the deployed UI exactly per spec: essential-self-name and essential-ideal-name both read 'The Voyager and The Challenger', the subtitle 'Two patterns, named together' is present in both cards, and essential-self-tie / essential-ideal-tie both carry 'The Voyager and The Challenger sit 0 points apart — closer than the 5 points this instrument can tell apart. We name both rather than choosing between them.' The non-tied ui.demo essential result (empath primary, adventurer secondary, delta 8.2) renders the single-archetype presentation unchanged — name 'The Empath', subtitle 'Connection & Intimacy · with a secondary of The Voyager', no tie note, no essential-self-tie testid. /methodology essential entry contains 'name both rather than choosing' and no correlation / separation / ratio wording leaks to reader. No 'of 10' phrase leaks anywhere on the essential result page (norms-pause regression holds). API contract verified: POST /api/v2/assessments + PUT responses + POST /complete return a per-lens 'tie' object with keys tied/gap/margin (and keys/names/note when tied); a fresh all-3s session produced via the API returns tied=True, gap=0, margin=5, two names, on both lenses. Ownership enforcement: ui.demo cannot read the tied session's /result or /report.pdf (returns 403/404). Combined PDF (%PDF, > 20KB) renders for ui.demo; every instrument /result returns 200; Junction and Flag anonymous flows are green.
critical_code_review_comments: rank_archetypes in services/essential_scoring.py uses `sorted(items, key=lambda kv: (-score, key))` — correctly stable, breaks ties on key alphabetically rather than dict-insertion order. The test_an_exact_tie_is_not_broken_by_insertion_order guard proves it. Good.

_tie_block in routes/mirror_v2.py cleanly separates the tied and untied payload shape: both always carry tied/gap/margin/note; only the tied shape carries keys+names. Frontend uses optional chaining (`s.tie?.tied`) so older snapshots (no `tie` key at all, e.g. ui.demo) fall through to the pre-existing single-archetype presentation without a crash — regression path is safe.

Snapshot immutability observed: ui.demo's older essential /result payload has no `tie` key at all (snapshot minted before this change). Correct behaviour under the write-once rule; the frontend handles it. DISPLAY_VERSION bump to disp-1.3.1 means any new render mints a fresh snapshot that will include `tie`.

test_iteration15.py::TestTiedPdfAndProse::test_result_has_choosing_prose_naming_both greps the serialised `choosing` block for both archetype names — confirms crosscheck.build_synthesis and choosing._lens_name join both names when tied, so prose never quietly ranks two archetypes the reading declined to rank.

Minor observation: the essential result page renders `s.primary.description` under the tied header (i.e. Voyager's self_description text alone), even when the header names both Voyager AND Challenger. Not a spec violation — the tie note itself explicitly states 'we name both rather than choosing' and both names appear — but a reader may notice the description body only voices the first-named archetype. Product may want to consider suppressing the description block or merging both descriptions when tied. Recording as observation only, not a bug.

success_rate.frontend: 100% — tied result page + non-tied result page + /methodology all render exactly per spec

test_credentials: test.user@ratherknow.com / knowmore123 (tied session owner); ui.demo@ratherknow.com / knowmore123 (all-four-complete, non-tied essential)
seed_data_creation: One fresh essential session created via API in test_new_essential_all_3s_produces_tied_result (test.user), used only to prove the tied contract on POST+PUT+complete. Existing dd53396e-9745-4293-9e4c-cdb5d6296298 was used for all read-side checks.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Tie state is in production behaviour on disp-1.3.1: tied results carry keys/names/note; untied results carry tied=False/gap/margin/note. Older snapshots (e.g. ui.demo essential e3803d60-5a12-4c57-874f-83182f9c3fef) legitimately have no `tie` key at all — don't treat that as a bug, the frontend optional-chains through it. Use dd53396e-9745-4293-9e4c-cdb5d6296298 as the reference tied session; every item was answered 3 so all six archetypes score 50. TIE_MARGIN=5 is exclusive (gap<5 ties, gap==5 does not). Regression-critical: 'of 10' must never appear on any reader-facing essential/personality surface; test_iteration15 asserts it.
